appNode.description:
The node which handled the request. Normally, {@link ImplLanguage.Session sessions} are sticky, but if the initial
node does, it will be handed over to a new node. Subsequent requests for this session should
{@link ImplLanguage.Session#appNode specify the new node} so they are correctly routed.

errorName.description: The error code/exception name if #status is `error` (`ename` in the Jupyter protocol).

errorValue.description: The exception string if #status is `error` (`evalue` in the Jupyter protocol).

stackTrace.description: The stack backtrace if #status is `error` (`traceback` in the Jupyter protocol).

cellId.description:
The client-specified unique identifier of the cell, from the {@link ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteSpec#cellId spec}.

@see ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteSpec#cellId

userExpressions.description:
A map of names to results of the execution of the user expressions (`user_expressions` in the Jupyter protocol).

@see ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteSpec#userExpressions

data.description: Result data in various rendered formats.

metadata.description: Any metadata that describes the data.

transient.description: Optional transient data not to be persisted to a notebook or other document.

name: ImplLanguage.Session.ExecuteResult
